primary_sources_checked.result: Checked Gaza humanitarian situation reporting and targeted health/access terms. The latest retrievable relevant OCHA situation report remained 18 September 2026; no newly published OCHA Gaza report or new health-system, hospital, ambulance/transport, fuel, medical-evacuation, functioning-capacity, or access disruption was found in this run's observation window.

Checked the WHO Israel/oPt emergency page and WHO Gaza/occupied Palestinian territory health reporting. The newest relevant official item found was the Director-General's 24 September 2026 UNGA remarks, which predated this observation window; no new WHO health-system, hospital, ambulance/transport, fuel, medical-evacuation, functioning-capacity, or access disruption was found in the window.

coverage_notes.deduplication: Same-day reports located during this run concerned incidents already surfaced earlier: the Wijdan Camp/Al-Mawasi vehicle strike, Batn al-Sameen artillery injuries, Al-Zawaida displacement-tent injuries, the Al-Sawarha Cemetery fatal strike, and previously available WHO/UNRWA policy-health statements. These were excluded as duplicates or pre-window follow-ups without a material new fact.
coverage_notes.limitations: WHO EMRO's news-index endpoint returned a transient 502, but official WHO search results and the WHO emergency page were accessible and checked. A guessed OCHA 25 September situation-report URL was not accessible, while OCHA domain search returned no such new report. These access issues did not materially prevent coverage because alternative official WHO/OCHA surfaces were successfully queried.
coverage_notes.ledger_context: No pre-existing Gaza watch-ledger path was present on ops/watch-ledger at run start, so deduplication for this run also used developments already surfaced in the active watch conversation.
